text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing the fierce clash of Tamamo 
Cross and the others up close, Mejiro 
Ardan feels not fear, but sheer delight at 
its breathtaking brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Countless formidable rivals and 
competitors lead the way ahead; as long as 
one can battle them with all one's heart 
and soul, one's growth is truly limitless—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this newfound realization, Mejiro 
Ardan felt her heart flutter with 
excitement toward her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, Sakura Chiyono O was 
watching the Tenno Sho (Autumn) on TV, 
witnessing Mejiro Ardan's growth 
firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan steps forward toward the 
Osaka Hai. However, she has no way of 
knowing about the shadow that fell across 
Sakura Chiyono O's face...
